definitions.name: FlashLight

protocol.summary: S1 selects FLASH/TORCH internally. EN pulses 1..8 encode 100..30% at nominal 220ms; 9..16 encode the same eight relative codes at nominal 1300ms. Torch EN high is steady on; long low >500us resets.
gaps: Recommended pulse envelope is qualification, not a claim other widths fail on silicon.
Torch EN PWM description conflicts with the datasheet FLASH-pin PWM path; no waveform model admitted.
Original UIFlow2 long-flash multiplication differs from Table 1.

flash-mode.label: Flash 模式（关闭为 Torch，仅创建时可选）

last-edge-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

first-rise-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

settle-at-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

timeout-at-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

edge-trace-ns.description: Bounded oldest-to-newest [QEMU virtual nanoseconds, actual EN pad level 0/1]. Reads across fields are not an atomic snapshot.

evidence.known_issue: brightness*time emits the wrong command for seven of eight 1300ms requests; retain original bytes as negative controls.

runtime.blocker: Only the exact recorded nominal digital subsets are admitted; full 16-code guest/PWM/dynamic-S1/physical equivalence remain open. Partial nominal digital model: only qualified GPIO bitbang HI/LO 750..10000ns and steady Torch. Last-rise+500us latch and first-rise+nominal deadline are explicit model policies. No LEDC waveform, EN PWM, dynamic S1, reset-callback guarantee, analog/electrical/optical/current/thermal or bit-exact equivalence. Guest and Web validation must bind the exact host/firmware/runtime; none is inherited from C tests. Route-history qualification is not latched: restoring a previously unsupported route can re-expose old known state without a fresh EN reset (UNIT-HOST-38); such transitions are outside admission.

guest_validation.scope: Exact selected Flash and Torch source paths; individually qualified programs only. No all-16-code or physical claim.

model_policies.latch: last observed rising edge + 500000ns stable high
model_policies.torch: steady EN high, no Flash deadline; EN PWM unqualified
model_policies.mode_selection: creation-only synthetic fixture; default Flash; frozen after all initial values
model_policies.cold_start: A route-only transition without a pad edge can remain unknown; selected tests explicitly drive EN high-to-low then low >500us. No constructor-only known-off claim.
model_policies.route_history: Current route/pad mismatch suppresses output. An observed unsupported-route interval is not latched; return to GPIO can restore prior qualification without reset. Continuous qualified GPIO only; UNIT-HOST-38 remains open.

cores3.scope: Original single pulse and nominal timeout, explicit long-low reset/recovery, known steady Torch, actual original-driver encoding observations, invalid/out-of-envelope unknown. Only qualified observed commands; no full table guest or hardware equivalence.
cores3.browser_scope: Five mounted Torch on/off/unknown/recovery phases; 72 direct GET and actual material evidence. Four optional browser HTTP200 body captures are zero bytes; never used as PNG evidence. Metadata SHA is not full texture-transfer attestation.

limitations: Partial nominal digital model: only qualified GPIO bitbang HI/LO 750..10000ns and steady Torch. Last-rise+500us latch and first-rise+nominal deadline are explicit model policies. No LEDC waveform, EN PWM, dynamic S1, reset-callback guarantee, analog/electrical/optical/current/thermal or bit-exact equivalence. Guest and Web validation must bind the exact host/firmware/runtime; none is inherited from C tests.
No calibrated outer-shell S1 detent binding or LED color temperature measurement.
UNIT-HOST-36 reset-observer gap remains open; a mismatched pad revokes output-known.

definitions.name: FlashLight

protocol.summary: S1 selects FLASH/TORCH internally. EN pulses 1..8 encode 100..30% at nominal 220ms; 9..16 encode the same eight relative codes at nominal 1300ms. Torch EN high is steady on; long low >500us resets.
gaps: Recommended pulse envelope is qualification, not a claim other widths fail on silicon.
Torch EN PWM description conflicts with the datasheet FLASH-pin PWM path; no waveform model admitted.
Original UIFlow2 long-flash multiplication differs from Table 1.

definitions.input_semantics: S1 is an explicit synthetic creation fixture, frozen after all initial values; flash-mode true is Flash, false is Torch. No live S1 setter.
definitions.output_semantics: Read-only controller state. output-known plus route and pad synchronization qualify active. Relative Flash code is not luminance; Torch uses no Flash code/deadline.

limitations: Partial nominal digital model: only qualified GPIO bitbang HI/LO 750..10000ns and steady Torch. Last-rise+500us latch and first-rise+nominal deadline are explicit model policies. No LEDC waveform, EN PWM, dynamic S1, reset-callback guarantee, analog/electrical/optical/current/thermal or bit-exact equivalence. Guest and Web validation must bind the exact host/firmware/runtime; none is inherited from C tests.
No calibrated outer-shell S1 detent binding or LED color temperature measurement.
UNIT-HOST-36 reset-observer gap remains open; a mismatched pad revokes output-known.

definitions.name: FlashLight

gaps: Recommended pulse envelope is qualification, not a claim other widths fail on silicon.
Torch EN PWM description conflicts with the datasheet FLASH-pin PWM path; no waveform model admitted.
Original UIFlow2 long-flash multiplication differs from Table 1.
